result.summary: Produced a compiling TikZ reconstruction (version 1) of 3477_q_fig1.png. It draws the named points A, B, C, D, E, F at measured coordinates, with edges A-D-C, C-E-B, D-E-F, and A-B-F, plus an unlabelled stub past F. The Critic scored it 0.92, topology check passed, all six labels present, and must_repair is false. The only remaining issue is a low-severity note that the strokes are slightly heavier than the original (1.0pt vs thinner).
